source_context.caption_hook: Forecasting is not guessing — it’s structured decision making.
caption_argument_segments: Forecasting is not guessing — it’s structured decision making.
Choosing the right forecasting method can directly impact: ✔ Inventory levels ✔ Capacity utilization ✔ Customer delivery performance
Here are 4 widely used forecasting techniques every planner should know:
🔹 Naive / Simple Average Best for stable demand with minimal variation. Quick and easy starting point.
🔹 Simple Moving Average (SMA) Smooths fluctuations by averaging past ‘n’ periods. Ideal for moderate variability.
🔹 Weighted Moving Average (WMA) Gives more importance to recent data (e.g., 0.5, 0.3, 0.2). Useful when trends are changing.
